summary: vmware.vmware_rest deprecates turbo mode and VMWARE_ENABLE_TURBO, removed in 5.0.0.
questions: Is turbo mode deprecated in vmware_rest?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest turbo mode deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: Turbo mode and the `VMWARE_ENABLE_TURBO` environment variable are deprecated and will be removed in **vmware.vmware_rest 5.0.0**.
